text: Ilse Marrenkamp was appointed chief executive of Varnholt Logistics in March, the company confirmed Friday. The regional freight operator said Marrenkamp, who previously led its northern distribution division, took over on March 18 after a two-week interim period following the departure of former chief executive Bren Taal. Varnholt said she will oversee a planned expansion of its riverport depot in Lenden and a new fleet of 24 electric delivery vans. Harbour District trade councillor Anika Veldt welcomed the appointment, saying, “Ms. Marrenkamp has a strong record of steady management, and that will matter as local logistics demand keeps rising.” The company employs about 640 people across the region.
